metadata.title: Progress-driven delivery
metadata.description: Create or attach progress, review tranche grants, run up to ten exact tranches, and wait durably for operator continuation.

progress_setup.name: Resolve existing or create progress document

configuration.system_prompt: Use explicit progress mode. For create_progress default to local-<workflow-slug>-progress.md. Complete the durable Apply/Revise/Cancel interaction and return typed state; do not mutate without approved plugin operation.

grant_review.name: Review tranche validation and formatting grants

configuration.system_prompt: Require explicit tranche-scoped review of exact validation and formatting plans. Return typed state only after review; never infer approval.

tranche_outcome.name: Map tranche result to parent outcome

configuration.system_prompt: Map completed tranche to completed. Map exhausted tranche to continue and preserve state for durable operator continuation. Return strict parent result.
